_note: Standard-size objects for fixing a 3D clip's scale (civil/scene_scale.py). Built 2026-11-20 from Research Desk's catalog (Project_CIVIL/research/scene-scale-references.json, as of 2026-11-20) by picking Thai rows: Verified sizes from DOH, DRR, BMA, TISI, DLT and UN documents, plus derived (Inference) ones marked in source_note. A size with no rel_error or tolerance gets a cautious ±10 % in the app. CIVIL_SCENE_REFS can point to another file. vertical: true marks a height.
